final_value: Read-only Git-state inspection with optional locks disabled and zero Git mutation.

final_value: Existing repository SHA-256 manifest without an archive, backup, or duplicate tree.
review_rationale: Direct file hashes prove integrity; an archive hash requires a prohibited archive.
